label: RTL-SDR (R820T / R820T2 / R860)
notes: 2.048 MS/s is the long-standing sweet spot — 2.4 MS/s flirts with USB drops on R820T. No analog filter ladder; AGC + tuner gain only. The advertised low range [225 k, 300 k] struggles to lock the R820T PLL and is omitted from the quick list; it's still reachable via the advanced panel.
